lineage: NG6 fold convention re-inherited (calendar thirds, window 2015+)

q6_floor.law: fail-closed kill recorded, never silently dropped
q6_floor.note: counts materialize at census time; the freeze (window, rule, boundaries) is source-independent and frozen BEFORE any census

regime_law: window 2015+: the 2020-03 deleveraging sits in F2, the 2022 bear in F3; 2008Q4–2009 predates the window so the never-share rule (2008Q4–2009 and 2020-03 never in one fold) is moot
rule: three chronological folds; boundaries = exact calendar thirds of the window computed on DATES, independent of event/price data; F1 = [start, B1], F2 = (B1, B2], F3 = (B2, end]; decision assigned by decision DATE
